title: 1999 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Rabbit
seo_title: 1999 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Rabbit (16 February – 4 February 2000)
description: 1999 is the Year of the Earth Rabbit (Yin, Ji-mao), from 16 February 1999 to 4 February 2000. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1999.
lead: Born in 1999? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Rabbit, but check the date: the 1999 Earth Rabbit year began on 16 February 1999. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1999: Year of the Earth Rabbit, from 16 February 1999 to 4 February 2000.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1999 was the Year of the Rabbit. It began with Lunar New Year on 16 February 1999 and ended on 4 February 2000, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1999 ends in 9, which makes it an Earth year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1999 is a Ji-mao year. The same Earth Rabbit combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1939 before it and 2059 after it.
Lunar New Year 1999 fell on 16 February 1999, so everyone born in January 1999, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Tiger.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Rabbit guide describes the sign like this: “Gentle, thoughtful, and diplomatic. Rabbits value harmony and are skilled at avoiding conflict.” The usual watch-out: “Can be overly cautious and avoid necessary confrontation.”

The Earth element adds its own flavour. Earth years bring stability, practicality, and patience. People of this element tend to be dependable, grounded, and good at long-term planning. Read more in our Earth element guide, or the full Year of the Rabbit page.
Careers often linked with the Rabbit: diplomacy, counseling, design, hospitality.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1999
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Rabbit's best matches are the Goat, Pig and Dog, and its clash sign is the Rooster, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Rabbit, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Rabbit, it shares the Goat's triangle (Rabbit, Goat and Pig), so 2027 is traditionally favourable. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Rabbit years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1975 (Wood Rabbit); 1987 (Fire Rabbit); 2011 (Metal Rabbit); 2023 (Water Rabbit). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1999 is the Year of the Rabbit, a Yin Earth Rabbit year (Ji-mao).
When does the 1999 Year of the Rabbit start and end?
It starts on 16 February 1999 and ends on 4 February 2000.
I was born in January 1999. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Tiger: Lunar New Year 1999 was on 16 February 1999, so all of January 1999 belongs to the Tiger year.
Earth. 1999 ends in 9, which belongs to Earth, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Rabbit compatible with?
Traditionally the Goat, Pig and Dog. The Rabbit's clash sign is the Rooster.
